deferred_gates: Independent review of design08, new protocol/test, source-evidence02, inputs02, core, manifest, contract15, and exact source closure after creation
Actual source build, core/manifest validation, admission, bridge, replay, analyzer, and launch; none is authorized by this design amendment

approved_narrow_scope: The prospective candidate may change the working protocol14 and its test in a new append-only acquisition/source commit. This is a new source identity; it is not a rewrite or relabeling of the old source identity.

The new candidate must bind the changed protocol/test bytes, runner/core, source-evidence02, inputs02, design08, and contract15 to the new source commit. The old contract14 remains bound to old source commit ac0af and its old source-input SHA set.

Canonical replacement14 core and manifest outputs are fresh because their canonical identity and manifest paths were absent at this review. They may be created exactly once at those canonical paths, but an existing path or any old output bytes must fail closed; no replacement14 contract, source-evidence01, design07, ledger, or historical sidecar may be overwritten.

No duplicate full module-graph or output namespace is required solely to carry this two-field unsealed source-validator correction. Runtime output directories and attempt namespaces still require their existing exclusive fresh-output guards.
historical_identity_boundary: Old source commit ac0af, old protocol/test path bytes as recovered from that commit, contract14, design07, source-evidence01, and all ledger/capture rows remain immutable predecessor evidence.

A path name shared between old and new source commits does not transfer authority: every old validation/recovery path must use the old committed blob/source identity, while the new contract15 must verify the new committed blob and exact SHA before any new output.

The new source design is design08, predecessor must be exact design06, and the baseline is design06.reviewed_baseline_head=9b71cce939ac74d9674be189ee03dbee14b868e9; actual_observed_head must not be invented or substituted.

required_near_misses: Reuse of contract14, source-evidence01, or inputs01 for the new source commit
New protocol/test SHA differs from the new contract15 source closure or is accepted by path alone
Design07 or design04 used as design08 predecessor, or current HEAD substituted for reviewed baseline 9b71
Copied 417-entry closure omitting new acquisition/evidence/input paths
Existing canonical core/manifest path or any historical output overwritten
Old source validation/recovery silently reads mutable working bytes instead of the exact old committed blob

required_new_bindings.closure: complete ordered status/path/before/after SHA closure from 9b71cce939ac74d9674be189ee03dbee14b868e9 through the new immediate base, including the prior design07 closure and all new append-only paths

contract.must_bind: new source commit, exact new protocol/test/source closure, design08, source-evidence02, inputs02, and fresh core identity

required_new_bindings.source_delta: preserve exactly the nine Rust paths and tested Rust bytes; protocol/evidence/input additions are append-only source/base closure and must not be smuggled into old contract14

source_evidence.must_be: new bytes; source-evidence-01 is never rewritten

required_new_bindings.source_inputs: new inputs02 collector/config; actual source-inputs-actual-01 is never rewritten

successor_design.immediate_patch_base: exact newly sealed append-only acquisition base commit
